title: Driven three-cycle path-space KL audit recovers the Schnakenberg current x affinity closed form EPR = beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b))
scientific_domain: Nonequilibrium statistical mechanics / stochastic thermodynamics (finite-state discrete-time Markov chains)
argument_family: closed-form-derivation-plus-numerical-match (a finite-state algebraic identity, cross-checked numerically against a bias sweep)
revised_one_sentence_claim: On SBT's autonomous lifted-protocol benchmark, the steady-state path-space KL (time-reversal-asymmetry) audit of the biased three-cycle clock has the closed form EPR(S,s) = (p-q)log(p/q) = beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)), and the full lifted-chain audit equals alpha*beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)) by the decomposition lemma; this has the same algebraic form as Schnakenberg's (1976) cycle current x affinity (with cycle-basis affinity A_cycle = 3log(p/q) and cycle current J_cycle = (1/3)(p-q)), is a RECOVERY of a 1976 identity on a hand-chosen kernel where every symbol is an input, with no fitted constants and zero independent data points, and EPR is an informational path-space KL proxy, NOT physical entropy production.
new_minimum_viable_result: A self-contained one-page note that (1) states the autonomous lifted kernel (eq:lifted_kernel) and the biased three-cycle clock (p=beta(1+b)/2, q=beta(1-b)/2, stay=1-beta), (2) fills in the explicit 6-directed-edge EPR sum behind the paper's 'a direct calculation gives' (Protocol_Trap line 274), yielding (p-q)log(p/q)=beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)) [verified here: edge-sum vs closed form diff ~1e-17 at b in {0.3,0.5,0.9}], (3) applies the decomposition lemma (eq:epr_clock_only) so EPR_lifted = alpha*EPR_clock [verified: full 9-state kernel EPR = alpha*EPR_clock to ~1e-16], (4) identifies the result with Schnakenberg current x affinity using the CYCLE-BASIS objects A_cycle = 3log(p/q) (closed-walk sum, No_Go def:closed-walk-sum line 591-599) and J_cycle = (1/3)(p-q), with the factors of 3 cancelling to (p-q)log(p/q) [verified: J_cycle*A_cycle = 0.49437553 = EPR at beta=0.9,b=0.5], and (5) states the b=0 null (protocol trap => EPR=0; verified machine-zero). Framed up front as RECOVERY of Schnakenberg (1976), already present in the corpus (ledger row 159; Protocol_Trap eq:epr_closed_form), with the informational-proxy caveat in the headline.
changes_made: NARROWED CLAIM: dropped 'steady-state entropy-production audit ... equals the textbook Schnakenberg current-times-affinity VALUE' (which reads as asserting equality with PHYSICAL entropy production, crossing ledger line 107 'no micro-thermodynamic interface') and replaced with 'path-space KL / time-reversal-asymmetry audit ... has the same algebraic form as Schnakenberg current x affinity', matching the source paper's own informational-proxy language (Protocol_Trap line 119).

CLARIFIED THE MAPPING (corrected a verified mislabeling): the card asserted J=(p-q) is 'the steady-state cycle current' and A=log(p/q) is 'the cycle affinity'. By No_Go def:closed-walk-sum (lines 591-599, citing Schnakenberg1976) the 3-cycle affinity is the closed-walk sum A_cycle=3log(p/q) and the stationary cycle current at uniform occupation is J_cycle=(1/3)(p-q). The factors of 3 cancel so EPR=J_cycle*A_cycle=(p-q)log(p/q) is correct, but log(p/q) is a PER-EDGE log-ratio, not the cycle affinity. Verified numerically: J_cycle*A_cycle = 0.4943755299006494 = (p-q)log(p/q).

CONVERTED RHETORIC TO A LEMMA: the unstated 'a direct calculation gives' (Protocol_Trap line 274) is made an explicit 6-edge-sum lemma; verified that the edge-sum reproduces the closed form to ~1e-17.

RECLASSIFIED CONTRIBUTION AS EXPOSITORY: the formula is already claimed in the corpus (ledger already_claimed_retrodictions row 159; Protocol_Trap eq:epr_closed_form line 281). Reframed the deliverable's only new content as the explicit edge-sum (expository transparency), not a scientific result.

REMOVED OVERSELL: dropped 'the single most parameter-disciplined quantitative anchor in the SBT corpus' framing in favor of 'RECOVERY, not prediction', since the 'match' is the formula evaluated against its own evaluation (data_points_matched=0).

FLAGGED LIFT- AND COMMON-PI-DEPENDENCE AS CHOSEN: the additive split EPR_lifted=alpha*EPR_clock is specific to the random-scan lift's disjoint phase/state edge supports (paper: 'not the only possible lift') and to the hand-imposed common-pi reversibility that zeroes the (1-alpha) term (paper: 'The assumption of a common stationary pi is essential'); these are inputs, not derived.

RESTRICTED VALUE-ADD TO REORGANIZATIONAL CONTENT: the genuine contribution is the lifted-protocol decomposition EPR_lifted=alpha*EPR_clock plus the b=0 protocol-trap null, operationalizing 'P3 holonomy without P6 drive is not an arrow', protected by DPI (no false positives) -- not any improvement over the standard account.
remaining_objections: ZERO PREDICTIVE CONTENT (not repairable; intrinsic): every symbol (alpha, beta, b, K0, K1, pi, s, lens, lift) is a modeler input; data_points_matched=0; the 'numerical match' is the closed form evaluated against its own evaluation. As a retrodiction/prediction it is empty -- it is a recovery of a 1976 identity.

ALREADY IN THE CORPUS (not repairable): ledger row 159 explicitly states 'driven 3-cycle EPR = beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)) is the standard current-times-affinity form', and Protocol_Trap states eq:epr_closed_form. The marginal contribution is a homework-grade edge-sum lemma; nothing scientifically new.

IMPORTS KNOWN PHYSICS WHOLESALE (not repairable): the EPR/affinity object IS Schnakenberg's Markov-network thermodynamic force (ledger hidden_physics_dependence line 195); SBT supplies only finite-KL bookkeeping. The 'match' is true by construction because the same object is relabeled on both sides.

NO BASELINE ADVANTAGE (not repairable): the standard derivation (write cycle current and affinity, multiply) reaches the identical number with no SBT machinery (no lens, no completion endomap, no P1-P6). SBT recovers and re-frames, it does not beat the standard account.

DISCLAIMER PROXIMITY (repaired but must be honored): admissible ONLY under the strict informational/path-space-KL reading; any claim that the recovered number is PHYSICAL entropy production crosses the ledger 'no micro-thermodynamic interface' disclaimer (line 107).

NO LEAN CERTIFICATION (out of scope): the certified core covers deterministic partition lenses only (ledger line 111); the stochastic-kernel EPR identity and decomposition lemma are not machine-checked. The 'stronger_result' Lean lemma does not exist.

score_rationale.impact: 1.5 -- recovers a 1976 textbook identity on a toy kernel; the only audience value is a clean worked dictionary entry (SBT arrow audit <-> Schnakenberg affinity) and the b=0 null discipline. No new knowledge for a stat-mech specialist.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5.0 -- Class A, essentially already proved; the only new step is a few-line edge-sum; numerical verification is a sub-second script (run and confirmed here to ~1e-16).
score_rationale.plausibility: 5.0 -- the identity is trivially true and was verified three ways (edge-sum, factored form, full 9-state kernel) plus the cycle-basis bookkeeping; no doubt it holds.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 2.5 -- the cycle-affinity mechanism is genuinely reused (NG_FORCE_FOREST, NG_FORCE_NULL, protocol-trap null, A_ACC), so not a one-off; but the construction was reverse-engineered to land on Schnakenberg's form (p,q parameterized so p-q and p/q give the clean factors; K_phi chosen common-pi-reversible to zero the (1-alpha) term), capping this below 'forced'.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 0.5 -- opposite-world fully passes: the single knob b dials magnitude (and, via the signed current J=p-q, sign) continuously; b=0 gives machine zero. No observation could falsify an algebraic identity in modeler-controlled inputs. (Note: the EPR scalar itself is non-negative; only J and A flip sign, so the opposite-world claim is correctly stated in terms of the signed current.)
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4.0 -- crisp, fully explicit, reproducible, and speaks the stat-mech community's exact language (current x affinity, cycle basis); the cycle-basis correction makes it textbook-legible.
score_rationale.precision: 4.5 -- a sharp closed form with no fitted constants, verified to ~1e-16; capped just below 5 because precision is over the theory's OWN inputs and EPR is an informational proxy (disclaimer-bounded), not a physical dissipation rate.
score_rationale.robustness: 4.0 -- holds for all alpha in [0,1], all beta in (0,1], all b in [0,1); decomposition verified on the full kernel; but it is robust ONLY within the chosen random-scan lift and common-pi reversible kernels (a different lift need not split additively), so not unconditionally robust.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 0.5 -- none; the standard textbook derivation reaches the same number with zero SBT machinery. SBT does not beat the baseline.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 1.5 -- as a standalone result, unpublishable (already known, no new content). Its only home is as a worked appendix/note in Protocol_Trap filling the 'direct calculation' gap and supplying the cycle-basis identification; the reorganizational P3-without-P6 framing is the publishable kernel, not the number.

bin_rationale: B (foundational sanity check). This is a correct-but-already-known RECOVERY whose value is as an internal consistency anchor and a Rosetta-stone dictionary entry (SBT path-space KL audit <-> Schnakenberg current x affinity), with a clean null-vs-driven discipline (b=0 => EPR=0 by the protocol trap, DPI => no false positives). provenance.card_one_sentence_claim: The steady-state entropy-production audit of SBT's autonomous biased-three-cycle clock equals the textbook Schnakenberg current-times-affinity value EPR(S,s)=(p-q)log(p/q)=beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)), and the full lifted-protocol audit equals alpha*beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)), with every symbol fixed by the kernel construction and no fitted constants.
provenance.target_known_fact: Schnakenberg (1976) network thermodynamics: the steady-state entropy production rate of a driven Markov cycle equals the sum over cycles of (cycle current) x (cycle affinity); for a single biased pair EPR = (current)*(affinity) = (p-q)*log(p/q).

Clock weight beta in (0,1] (default 0.9): overall forward/backward move probability (1-beta is the self-loop).
Random-scan mixing weight alpha in [0,1] (default 0.5): convex weight; overall prefactor in EPR_lifted=alpha*EPR_clock.
Conditional kernels (K_phi)=(K0,K1,K0) and the two reversible 3x3 kernels K0,K1 (chosen so each EPR(K_phi,pi)=0); inputs, not derived.

The phase ring has uniform stationary distribution s.
A_AUT autonomy: the clock/phase is part of the state with time-homogeneous dynamics; the biased clock is the sole drive (no external schedule).
Finite-state discrete-time (A_FIN); EPR treated as a pure path-space KL rate with NO physical local-detailed-balance / reservoir interpretation.
At least three states (2x2 doubly-stochastic kernels commute), so |X|=|Phi|=3 is the minimal nontrivial benchmark.

opposite_world_test.explanation: The single drive knob b dials the arrow continuously: b=0 gives a NULL world (EPR=0, verified machine zero); the signed cycle current J=p-q flips sign for b<0 or a forward/backward label swap (the EPR scalar itself is non-negative, so only J and A flip sign while EPR stays >=0 -- a correction to the card's phrasing); any non-negative magnitude in range is reachable. Because EPR=J*A is an algebraic identity in modeler-controlled inputs, no observation could falsify it. The protective discipline (protocol trap b=0 => DB => 0; DPI => no false positives from coarse-graining) prevents FALSE POSITIVES but does not give the result predictive content.

Opposite-world passes. Mechanism cycle-affinity reused across >=2 facts (NG_FORCE_FOREST/NULL, protocol-trap null, A_ACC). Imports known physics wholesale. Admissible only under the informational path-space-KL reading; the card's 'entropy-production' phrasing approached the disclaimed micro-thermodynamic interface and was repaired. Genuine value-add is reorganizational (EPR_lifted=alpha*EPR_clock decomposition + b=0 null operationalizing 'P3 without P6 is not an arrow'). SBT recovers and re-frames; it does not beat the standard account.
